gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-esteban: Galaxy draws every letter as one unbroken ribbon of line, dense and tall, with loose spacing between them. Esteban swells only slightly, like a barely pressed round brush, and keeps its e from ever squeezing shut.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-faustina: Cosmic from the first letter, Galaxy draws each stroke with technical-pen steadiness and generous spacing. And Faustina does the quieter job, thinning its bowls gently without turning spindly, its capitals barely above the lowercase.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-halant: Halant narrows gradually from stem to terminal, its outward-pointing ends and towering x-height giving it real authority. Galaxy is best at unvarying display lines, Halant at gradual, traditional text.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-headland-one: Headland One reads dignified and traditional, its letters set well apart. Galaxy is best at a plain stripe of constant ink, while the body's light but visible stroke variation does the reading.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-hedvig-letters-seri: Hedvig Letters Serif reads sturdy and authoritative, its open-ended curves carrying a slight tug of heavier verticals. Galaxy brings dowel-straight, loosely spaced display strength; the body does the quiet lifting.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-lisu-bosa: Lisu Bosa stands tall and sturdy, its counters spilling into open space. Against Galaxy's wire-cut strokes, the body's lightly flexed contrast makes the pair's clearest difference: rigid line above, springy line below.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-marcellus-sc: Dignified and literary, the body font carries tall, gently modulated letters with terminals pulled well back. Marcellus SC would carry paragraph after paragraph with steady dignity, leaving Galaxy's flat, unvarying line to the heading.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-montagu-slab: Galaxy gives crossbars the full weight of its stems, one loose, unbroken line that never lets up. Montagu Slab reads comfortably on screen, its weight shifting gradually rather than snapping.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-serif-hentaiga: Noto Serif Hentaigana reads refined and traditional, with open jaws on its curves. Galaxy supplies one flat, cosmic line weight for the heading, while the body adds a faint but real thick-thin shift beneath.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-ovo: Constant marker line over modest, close-look contrast. Galaxy holds one loose, tall, dense stroke for the heading, while Ovo keeps thins only slightly lighter than its thicks, with spacious curve terminals.
